title: A New Monomer Ce(III) Complex Based on Bis[(2-pyridyl)methylene]pyridine-2,6-dicarbohydrazone: Synthesis, DNA Binding, Apoptosis, and Molecular Docking

material_class.structural_family: double-stranded helical linear trinuclear Ce(III) complex

synthesis.procedure: Bis[(2-pyridyl)methylene]pyridine-2,6-dicarbohydrazone (37.3 mg, 0.1 mmol) and (NH4)2Ce(NO3)6 (164.4 mg, 0.3 mmol) were added to 15 mL DMF/MeOH (V/V = 1:5) and stirred for 1 h. The suspension was transferred into a 20 mL glass bottle and kept at 60 °C for 3 days. After natural cooling to ambient temperature, the products were washed with methanol and orange lumpy crystals were obtained by filtration.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal/hydrothermal in a 20 mL glass bottle
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to ambient temperature, washed with methanol, orange lumpy crystals isolated by filtration
